title: Theorem E (corrected after review): cusp degeneration bound |Z| <= w_N p^2 on valid triples
question: Corrected statement of HYP-38005bec per REV-3b9427bd-4cd4-40c1-8ab9-681ccbd44c5b
claims: VERBATIM from RUN-d55e8925 review report: (Theorem D, corrected) Let N >= 3, p > 2N prime, V := {tau in F_p^3 : 4A^3+27B^2 != 0, W(tau) != 0} (the valid triples, on which mindeg_N is defined and equals deg of the interpolant), Z := {tau in V : c_{N-1}(tau) = 0}. If p does not divide Num(tau0) (always true for target k^2; for target k iff p not in Bad_N), then |Z| <= w_N p^2, hence mindeg(N) = N-1 for all tau in V \ Z. [|F_p^3 \ V| is separately bounded by (6 + deg W) p^2 and is not covered by this theorem.]
next_action: None by strategic correction (no further interpolation lower-bound work unless it unblocks an algorithm). Optional: Lean formalization of D0.
notes: One blind review (accept with corrections). Not formalized. Does not prove C* beyond N < p^{1/4} regime; not an algorithm.
